programme_facts.value: When you use Build a Transfer Map to search for a major, you can “favorite” that major by clicking on the heart icon. Keeping track of majors you might be interested in is helpful when you are first exploring degree options. You can compare how your transfer courses fulfill recommendations in various majors, and “favorite” those transfer maps for future reference.
